estimator_1_capitalisation.unit: one maximal run of capitalised tokens in the shipped Speechmatics transcript surviving the documented exclusion rules (estimator, not gold)
estimator_1_capitalisation.surface_form: run tokens lowercased, punctuation stripped, possessive removed, whitespace collapsed
estimator_1_capitalisation.repeat_payoff: (mentions - distinct forms) / mentions within one episode
estimator_1_capitalisation.aggregation_primary: unweighted mean over episodes (matches the AMI/earnings21 census aggregation)
exclusions: first-person pronoun I / I'm / I've / I'll / I'd

role, title and honorific tokens stripped from the head of a run; a run made only of them is dropped (MeetingBank analogue of AMI's closed-set PARTICIPANT subtypes). Includes the Speechmatics rendering of Boston's 'Councilor' as 'Counselor'/'Counsel'
discourse tokens an ASR capitalises mid-utterance, and bare geographic heads left by a truncated run (street, avenue, park, west, ...)
generic institutional and procedural forms (city council, public comment, docket, ordinance, roll call, pledge of allegiance, ...)

estimator_2_legistar_roster.source: Metadata/MeetingBank.json itemInfo: per-bill file number, type and Summary (the Legistar agenda-item description)
estimator_2_legistar_roster.roster_definition: distinct proper-name candidate forms extracted from the meeting's own item Summaries by the same estimator, plus the meeting's own file numbers
estimator_2_legistar_roster.match_loose: either string is a contiguous token subsequence of the other
estimator_2_legistar_roster.leakage_warning: the Legistar Summary IS MeetingBank's summarisation reference. On the summarisation surface a metadata-derived glossary is Tier-M1 (reference-derived), not Tier-M0, and is therefore ceiling/diagnostic only - the registered provenance factorisation cannot be run cleanly on this corpus's primary valid surface.

static_city_roster_vs_episode_local.method: per-city roster built leave-one-meeting-out by document frequency; mention-weighted coverage; episode-local glossary = forms already spoken in the first half of the same episode

prospective_carry.method: glossary built from the first half of the episode only, scored on second-half mention coverage - no oracle, the cross-chunk carry question

repeat_payoff_sensitivity.note: estimator noise is overwhelmingly singleton, so it DEFLATES repeat payoff; the raw figure is a lower bound. Doc-frequency filters are positively correlated with within-episode recurrence and are therefore an upper bound.

comparators.note: from the committed 2026-08-17 entity-density census (docs/readiness/2026-08-17-entity-density-census.md); annotation-grounded, not estimator-based

reference_adequacy_limb.consequence: no WER-family or keyword-F glossary-GAIN claim can be scored on MeetingBank; valid surfaces remain summarisation, spoken QA and segmentation

verdict.overall: SPLIT: density limb 1 PASS by ~31x corpus-wide (1365/1366 episodes clear it); density limb 2 marginal - FAIL at 0.387 corpus-wide on the primary aggregation, PASS at 0.414 pooled, PASS at 0.412 on the >=90-minute slice, PASS on Alameda/Boston/Denver, FAIL on the landed 50-meeting flight subset at 0.358; reference-adequacy limb FAIL outright. MeetingBank can host a meeting-domain glossary claim only on the summarisation/QA/segmentation surface and only on a length-stratified subset; it cannot host an entity-WER or keyword-F glossary-GAIN claim.

reproduction.cost: CPU only, ~35 s for the full 1,366-transcript pass; no model contact, no downloads, no audio decoded
reproduction.output_discipline: aggregate statistics and entity surface forms only; no running transcript text is written to any committed file
